start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:keep-item-records with store {\"where\": \"postgresql database example_me on my own computer\", \"language\": \"SQL (PostgreSQL)\", \"credential_name\": \"example-me-postgres-connection\"} and writes [{\"item_ref\": \"p1\", \"scope_ref\": \"s1\", \"target_ref\": \"t1\", \"operation\": \"upsert\", \"expected_revision\": 0, \"event_ref\": \"e1\", \"fields\": {\"kind\": \"post\", \"body\": \"hi\"}}]."
no_lists_because: It names no list: the posts, replies, removals and effects are kept in the person's own store, in whatever form that store keeps things, and store says where and in which language.
instructions: 1. Keep the store's login in your vault under a name you choose, and say where the store is and how it is spoken to.
2. Say "Run workflow:keep-item-records" with store, and the writes and effects to keep.
3. The first run makes the store's own objects once and proves them on the example attempts; every attempt must be kept, repeated or refused as the intent says, or the run stops and says which.
4. Every later run keeps the new writes and effects, reads the space's live items back in creation order, and shows each reply under its parent.
